verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only UI-based (Online Filing Centre) and PDF/email/mail channels for incorporation, amendments and annual returns. The probe explicitly finds that the registry documents no transactional API on any surface checked. The open.canada.ca CKAN API is a separate national open-data platform, not a Corporations Canada API offering UI parity, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
